title: Bears’ Ben Johnson declares team ‘No. 1 regression candidate’ in Jaguars retort

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bears’ Ben Johnson declares team ‘No. 1 regression candidate’ in Jaguars retort
sources.description: Despite an NFC North title and a trip to the playoffs last year, Johnson is not resting on his laurels, especially after a slight dig from Jaguars coach Liam Coen about the attention that Caleb Williams receives.
